blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Only been 3 weeks, heres some backstory
blocks_element.text: Only been 3 weeks, heres some backstory I'm in my late teens and struggle with cystic, hormonal, and closed comedone acne. I've tried dozens of skincare plans, and my most recent was PanOxl cleanser, azelaic acid, and a moisturizer in the morning with adapeline and a night cream in the evening. my skin was getting worse, it was dry and flaky, and constantly peeling. After 4 months of this I decided to stop and I tried norse organics. Within 2 days the texture on my forehead was completely gone. While my cheeks still look pretty much the same, my skin is significantly less dry and patchy, and it FEELS healthier. Hopefully I get results soon-I still have a few weeks to go before I should see the full results, and I can't wait.

blocks_element.text: My son’s skin has definitely improved. He still has a few breakouts. It’s only been 4 weeks, so hopefully with time it will completely clear up.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · I've been suffering with hormonal acne n
blocks_element.text: I've been suffering with hormonal acne now for a few years, with some breakouts taking months to recover. Particularly this area at the side of my forehead, usually has 1 or 2 nasty red spots at any given time! I'm 2 weeks in to using the norse products and have noticed my skin feels just the right level of moisture. Not dry and inflamed from using harsh washes, and not craving the tonnes of moisurising products I normally use. My skin tone looks better, less red in areas. I have had a couple of new spots, but nothing swollen and nasty as yet and hopefully will clear quickly. I'm optomistic that continuing using norse organics will help to clear my acne problems, so far so good.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Been using Norse Organics for around 19
blocks_element.text: Been using Norse Organics for around 19 days now. I am getting used to the new routine of putting on the different balm at morning and night and then the scrub every couple of days. My spots have gotten smaller and not as easy to see but I am still getting some one or two new ones each day. I don’t think the my skin is as oily anymore in my T-zone and it is definitely not dry or flaky where the spots are. I find it a little difficult to put my tinted moisturiser over the day glow balm but maybe I haven’t perfected the application of the day balm yet as I do not want to use too much or too little. I am going to persevere with it as I want to give it the full 60 days to feel the most benefits.

blocks_element.text: Based on a 60-day clinical study conducted by Citruslabs (March 2026) on The Complete System for Acne-Prone Skin. Single-group, open-label design with participants aged 18 to 45 and self-reported acne concerns. No placebo control group. Percentages reflect the proportion of participants a board-certified dermatologist graded as showing improvement from baseline at day 60. Individual results may vary.

Self-reported participant perceptions from the same 60-day clinical study. Percentages reflect participants who agreed with the corresponding statement at the stated timepoint. These are subjective participant reports, not clinical diagnoses.
